description: Tasks whose required fields are whitespace-only strings. The validator trims before checking, so a whitespace-only value is treated the same as an empty one — each of these tasks must fail validation with a 'required' error on every required field that is whitespace-only. The fixture is the input to a rejection test, not a rendering test. It is the sibling of invalid-empty.json: same rule (required means non-empty after trim), different bytes (spaces, tabs, newlines instead of empty strings).
